name: Yungoos

changes.criterion: Group each Pokémon by its primary elemental type affinity as suggested by its physical description: Normal/colorless, Water/Ice, Fire/Electric, Grass/Poison, Psychic/Ghost/Dark, or Fighting/Rock/Ground/Steel. Assign each Pokémon to the type category most strongly implied by its described appearance, coloration, body features, and any explicitly mentioned materials or powers.
dimensions: normal_type (w=3): Score 1 if the Pokémon's description suggests a Normal-type affinity: it is described as an ordinary animal (mongoose, bird without elemental markings, etc.) with no strong elemental features, plain coloration, and no supernatural or elemental body traits. Score 0 if it has strong elemental features.

water_ice_type (w=3): Score 1 if the Pokémon's description strongly suggests Water or Ice affinity: aquatic body parts (fins, gills, flippers), water stored in body, blue watery coloration, amphibious traits, or ice/snow features. Score 0 if no such traits.

fire_electric_type (w=3): Score 1 if the Pokémon's description suggests Fire or Electric affinity: flame-like features, ember coloration (orange/red/yellow with heat connotations), lightning bolt markings, electrical organs, or spark-like body parts. Score 0 if no such traits.

grass_poison_type (w=3): Score 1 if the Pokémon's description suggests Grass or Poison affinity: plant parts integrated into body (leaves, vines, bulbs, flowers, roots), green plant-like coloration, or toxic/venomous features (purple spots, dripping liquid, fang-based poison). Score 0 if no such traits.

psychic_ghost_dark_type (w=3): Score 1 if the Pokémon's description suggests Psychic, Ghost, or Dark affinity: ghostly/shadowy body, single ominous eye, spoon-wielding humanoid, spectral appearance, dark shadowy coloration with supernatural features, or body described as ghostly or spirit-like. Score 0 if no such traits.

fighting_rock_ground_steel_type (w=3): Score 1 if the Pokémon's description suggests Fighting, Rock, Ground, or Steel affinity: stone or metal body material explicitly mentioned, muscular gorilla/humanoid fighter body, rocky texture, metallic parts, or described as biologically closer to stone. Score 0 if no such traits.
bipedal_humanoid (w=1): Score 1 if the Pokémon is explicitly described as bipedal, humanoid, or upright-standing; score 0 if quadrupedal, legless, or no clear upright bipedal stance described.

criterion: Group each Pokémon by its primary elemental type affinity as suggested by its physical description: Normal/colorless, Water/Ice, Fire/Electric, Grass/Poison, Psychic/Ghost/Dark, or Fighting/Rock/Ground/Steel. Assign each Pokémon to the type category most strongly implied by its described appearance, coloration, body features, and any explicitly mentioned materials or powers.
notes: The feedback strongly implies item_033 (Normal-type mongoose) groups with item_046 (Normal/Flying bird), item_051 (Ghost/Grass tree ghost), item_049 (Normal with cannons), item_005 (Psychic humanoid), item_019 (Rock type pot) rather than with other mammals item_034 (Dark), item_054 (Electric), item_039 (Water), item_035 (Fighting/Grass gorilla). This suggests the criterion is elemental type grouping, not biological archetype. The dimensions are designed so each Pokémon scores high on exactly one type-category dimension, creating natural clusters. item_033 as Normal, item_046 as Normal/Flying both score high on normal_type. item_051 and item_005 score on psychic_ghost_dark. item_049 may be Normal. item_019 scores on fighting_rock_ground_steel. This doesn't perfectly unify item_033 with all mentioned items, but type-based grouping is the best explanation for the feedback pattern.

name: Xatu

changes.criterion: Group each Pokémon by its primary type category as implied by its described appearance, body features, coloration, and any explicitly mentioned abilities or materials. The six categories are: (1) Normal/Flying — ordinary animals, birds, plain coloration, no strong elemental features; (2) Water/Ice — aquatic features, blue watery coloration, fins, amphibious; (3) Fire/Electric — flames, ember colors, lightning markings, electrical organs; (4) Grass/Poison — plant parts, green plant coloration, toxic features, purple bruise-like markings, wounds suggesting venom; (5) Psychic/Flying-Psychic/Ghost/Steel-Bell — psychic features (multiple brains, spoon, gelatinous psychic substance), ghostly/spectral bodies, totem-pole or bell-shaped metallic forms, bird Pokémon with mystical eye markings or spiritual designs; (6) Dark/Fighting/Rock/Ground — dark shadowy fur concealing face, muscular fighters, stone or rocky bodies, dark coloration with sinister traits.
dimensions: normal_flying_type (w=3): Score 1 if the Pokémon is described as an ordinary animal or bird with no strong elemental, supernatural, or plant features: plain coloration, typical animal body, bird without mystical markings or psychic traits, no totem/spiritual design. Score 0 if it has clear elemental, psychic, ghostly, plant, or dark features.

water_ice_type (w=3): Score 1 if the Pokémon's description strongly suggests Water or Ice affinity: aquatic body parts (fins, gills, flippers), water stored in body, blue watery coloration with amphibious traits, or ice/snow features. Score 0 if no such traits.

fire_electric_type (w=3): Score 1 if the Pokémon's description suggests Fire or Electric affinity: flame-like features, ember coloration (orange/red/yellow with heat connotations), lightning bolt markings, electrical organs, or spark-like body parts. Score 0 if no such traits.

grass_poison_type (w=3): Score 1 if the Pokémon's description suggests Grass or Poison affinity: plant parts integrated into body (leaves, vines, bulbs, flowers, roots), green plant-like coloration of a bulb or vegetable shape, or toxic/venomous features (purple bruise-like spots, dripping liquid, wounds suggesting venom, dark fur hiding injuries). Score 0 if no such traits.

psychic_ghost_steel_type (w=3): Score 1 if the Pokémon's description suggests Psychic, Ghost, or Steel affinity: explicitly mentioned psychic powers or multiple brains, ghostly or spectral appearance, gelatinous or ethereal body substance, bell-shaped or hollow metallic body, totem-pole or kachina-doll spiritual design with eye-like markings on wings or body, spoon-wielding humanoid, or ominous single eye. Score 0 if no such traits.

dark_fighting_rock_ground_type (w=3): Score 1 if the Pokémon's description suggests Dark, Fighting, Rock, or Ground affinity: dark black fur concealing the face, body covered in wounds or bruises suggesting a sinister/dark nature, muscular humanoid fighter body, stone or rocky texture explicitly described, metallic fighting parts, or described as biologically close to stone/earth. Score 0 if no such traits.

mystical_bird (w=2): Score 1 if the Pokémon is described as a bird (avian, feathered, beak, wings used for flight) AND has mystical, spiritual, psychic, or totem-like design elements (eye patterns on wings, totem pole resemblance, kachina doll design, described psychic abilities). Score 0 otherwise.

criterion: Group each Pokémon by its primary type category as implied by its described appearance, body features, coloration, and any explicitly mentioned abilities or materials. The six categories are: (1) Normal/Flying — ordinary animals, birds, plain coloration, no strong elemental features; (2) Water/Ice — aquatic features, blue watery coloration, fins, amphibious; (3) Fire/Electric — flames, ember colors, lightning markings, electrical organs; (4) Grass/Poison — plant parts, green plant coloration, toxic features, purple bruise-like markings, wounds suggesting venom; (5) Psychic/Flying-Psychic/Ghost/Steel-Bell — psychic features (multiple brains, spoon, gelatinous psychic substance), ghostly/spectral bodies, totem-pole or bell-shaped metallic forms, bird Pokémon with mystical eye markings or spiritual designs; (6) Dark/Fighting/Rock/Ground — dark shadowy fur concealing face, muscular fighters, stone or rocky bodies, dark coloration with sinister traits.
notes: The core problem: item_042 (Xatu - Psychic/Flying green trogon with totem/kachina design and eye markings on wings) was scoring on grass_poison_type due to green coloration, but it should group with item_007 (Bronzong-like bell/totem pole - Psychic/Steel), item_021 (Duosion/Exeggcute-like with two brains and psychic powers - Psychic), and item_043 (parrot bird). item_034 (Deino - Dark type, dark fur concealing face, wounds/bruises) and item_038 (Oddish - blue plant bulb with green leaves) should be in different groups. The key fix: item_042's green color should NOT score on grass_poison; instead its totem/kachina/eye-marking design should score on psychic_ghost_steel. I've redefined grass_poison to focus on plant body parts and bulb/vegetable shapes and toxic/dark-wound features. I've defined psychic_ghost_steel to include totem-pole and kachina-doll spiritual designs with eye markings. I've also added a mystical_bird binary to help item_042 cluster with psychic types. item_043 (parrot) should score on normal_flying. item_034 scores on dark_fighting_rock_ground due to dark concealing fur and wounds/bruises.

name: Dustox

changes.criterion: Group each Pokémon by its primary elemental and biological identity as conveyed by its described body, features, coloration, and abilities into six categories: (1) Animal/Flying/Bug — natural animals, birds, or insects/moths with no dominant elemental feature; (2) Water/Ice — aquatic or icy features; (3) Fire/Electric — flames, ember colors, electrical organs; (4) Grass/Poison — plant body parts OR toxic features (but NOT moth insects—those go in group 1); (5) Psychic/Ghost/Steel — psychic, spectral, robotic/mechanical, or spiritual features; (6) Dark/Fighting/Rock/Ground — dark concealing fur, muscular fighters, stone-like bodies.
dimensions: animal_flying_bug (w=3.5): Score 1 if the Pokémon is described as a natural animal, bird, or insect/arthropod (moth, butterfly, bug) with no dominant supernatural, elemental, plant, or mechanical features. Includes birds (even colorful parrots), moths, and ordinary quadrupedal animals without strong elemental identity. Score 0 if it has clear fire/electric/water/plant/psychic/ghost/steel/dark/rock features dominating its design.

water_ice_type (w=3): Score 1 if the Pokémon's description strongly suggests Water or Ice affinity: aquatic body parts (fins, gills, flippers), water stored in body, blue watery coloration with amphibious traits, eel-like aquatic body, or ice/snow features. Score 0 if no such traits.

fire_electric_type (w=3): Score 1 if the Pokémon's description suggests Fire or Electric affinity: flame-like features, ember coloration (orange/red/yellow with explicit heat connotations), lightning bolt markings, electrical organs explicitly mentioned, or spark-like body parts. Score 0 if no such traits.

grass_poison_type (w=3): Score 1 if the Pokémon's description suggests Grass or Poison affinity through plant body parts (leaves sprouting from body, vines, bulbs, flowers, roots as limbs) or a body explicitly described as a plant bulb or root vegetable shape. Score 0.5 if toxic features are present (toxic dust, venom) but the body is an insect/animal rather than a plant. Score 0 if no plant parts or toxic features. NOTE: a moth or insect that happens to have toxic dust scores low here; a blue plant bulb with leaves sprouting from head scores high.

psychic_ghost_steel_type (w=3.5): Score 1 if the Pokémon's description suggests Psychic, Ghost, or Steel/Mechanical affinity: explicitly mentioned psychic powers or multiple brains, ghostly or spectral appearance, gelatinous or ethereal body, bell-shaped or hollow metallic body, robotic/armored mechanical construction, totem-pole or kachina-doll spiritual design with eye-like markings, spoon-wielding humanoid, single ominous eye on a robotic body, or fairy/pixie with gem-studded psychic features. Score 0 if no such traits.

dark_fighting_rock_ground_type (w=3): Score 1 if the Pokémon's description suggests Dark, Fighting, Rock, or Ground affinity: dark black fur concealing the face, body covered in wounds or bruises suggesting a sinister/dark nature (but NOT toxic dust on insects), muscular humanoid fighter or genie-like powerful body, body explicitly described as biologically closer to stone, rocky or stony texture, or cannon/weapon appendages on a quadrupedal body. Score 0 if no such traits.

winged_animal (w=2.5): Score 1 if the Pokémon is described as having wings used for flight AND the overall body is that of a natural creature (bird, insect, moth, butterfly) rather than a supernatural entity, robot, or plant. Score 0 otherwise.

criterion: Group each Pokémon by its primary elemental and biological identity as conveyed by its described body, features, coloration, and abilities into six categories: (1) Animal/Flying/Bug — natural animals, birds, or insects/moths with no dominant elemental feature; (2) Water/Ice — aquatic or icy features; (3) Fire/Electric — flames, ember colors, electrical organs; (4) Grass/Poison — plant body parts OR toxic features (but NOT moth insects—those go in group 1); (5) Psychic/Ghost/Steel — psychic, spectral, robotic/mechanical, or spiritual features; (6) Dark/Fighting/Rock/Ground — dark concealing fur, muscular fighters, stone-like bodies.
notes: The key insight from round 3 feedback: item_031 (Venomoth, a moth) should group with item_043 (parrot bird), NOT with Grass/Poison plants like item_038 (Oddish) or item_051 (ghostly tree). Both item_031 and item_043 are winged natural creatures (insect and bird respectively). The fix: I created 'animal_flying_bug' as the primary dimension for natural animals/birds/insects, and added 'winged_animal' binary to pull moths and birds together. I also made grass_poison score lower for insects with toxic dust (they're animals first). The dark_fighting dimension now explicitly includes cannon-bearing quadrupeds like item_049 and genie-like muscular beings like item_028. Item_034 (Deino) stays in dark group via concealing fur and wounds. Item_019 (stone-like) stays in dark/rock group via 'biologically closer to stone' language.
